title: Polygon lookup oracle v1
description: Independent reference for the S11 done-test (DESIGN.md §13 S11, §15 D70-D71): seeded random points and the answers shapely computes on the unsimplified source geometry of a `tz_polygons` or `country_polygons` payload. Written by `dm-pipelines polygons build`; read by dm_civil_time's tests. Coordinates are integer micro-degrees, the same integers the Dart reader is given. Distances are metres in the local equirectangular projection of §15 D71 on a sphere of radius earthRadiusM, and are given only up to distanceLimitM (null beyond).

sourceVersion.description: Release of the source data, e.g. timezone-boundary-builder 2026e or Natural Earth 5.1.2.

samples.description: One entry per sampling scheme; names are unique.

name.description: sphere: uniform on the sphere; land: uniform on the sphere, kept only when a source polygon contains the point.

containing.description: Name of the source polygon that contains the point; null when none does.

nearest.description: Name of the nearest source polygon when none contains the point and one lies within distanceLimitM; otherwise null.

nearestDistanceM.description: Distance to `nearest`; null exactly when `nearest` is null.

otherDistanceM.description: Distance to the nearest source polygon whose name differs from containing (or from nearest when nothing contains the point); null when there is none within distanceLimitM or the point has neither.
